decision: PHASE 09Q BIR AUTHORITY CORPUS RESEARCH DESIGN PASS WITH STRICT RECOMMENDATIONS
baseCommit: c84d56b PHASE-09P-BIR-DOCUMENT-COMPLIANCE-TRANSMITTAL-SCAFFOLD-1 add document compliance transmittal scaffold
objective: Provide a design-only, non-runtime-active research design for how TINA will eventually discover, prioritize, verify, classify, and cite official Philippine tax/audit authorities (BIR issuances, NIRC/statutory provisions, Supreme Court/CTA jurisprudence, DOF/PEZA/SEC/BOI issuances) needed for BIR audit defense workflows. This scaffold designs the authority corpus research layer only; it performs no live search, scraping, browsing, downloading, ingestion, embedding, or database storage, and reaches no final legal or tax conclusion.

LOA_AUTHORITY_CORPUS.userQuery: What official authorities should we track for LOA validity and eLA authenticity research?

candidateAuthorities.title: NIRC Sec. 6(A)
candidateAuthorities.note: Statutory basis for LOA issuance authority.
